prompt: The backup endpoint in api.py returns 403 Forbidden when BACKUP_SECRET_TOKEN is not configured in the environment variables. Locate the source of this check and recommend how to handle a missing token configuration. Do NOT fix the bug yourself.

assertions.name: did_not_modify_code
assertions.description: Verifies that the agent did not make any edits to the source code files.

assertions.name: identified_token_check_lines
assertions.description: Verifies that the report specifies the lines in api.py checking the BACKUP_SECRET_TOKEN.

assertions.name: recommended_missing_config_handling
assertions.description: Verifies that the agent suggests handling or logging the missing configuration.
